raw_segments.text: Cornelius. The Queen, sir, very oft importun me to temper poisons for her, still pretending
the satisfaction of her knowledge only in killing creatures vile, as cats and dogs,
of no esteem. I dreading that her purpose was of more danger did compound for her a
certain stuff, which, being tan, would cease the present power of life, but in short time
all offices of nature should again do their due functions. Have you tan of it?
